# Tech Stack

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### Runtime and language

- **Language**: JavaScript ES2020 (`eslint.config.js` `ecmaVersion: 2020`; `package.json` `"type": "module"`)
- **Framework**: No primary framework (vanilla DOM widget class, no React/Vue/etc. in `package.json` dependencies)

| Aspect | Value |
|---|---|
| Language | JavaScript ES2020, ESM (`package.json:type=module`) |
| Framework | none — vanilla `LeadWidget` class over native DOM APIs (`src/ui/widget.js`) |
| Runtime target | Browser (client-side widget), built as IIFE exposing `window.WhatsAppLeadWidget` |
| Build tool | Vite `^6.0.0` (`vite.config.js`) with `@cloudflare/vite-plugin` `^1.33.1` |
| Hosting | Cloudflare Workers/Pages, static assets, SPA fallback, `nodejs_compat` (`wrangler.jsonc`) |
| Package manager | npm (`package-lock.json` present) |
| Deploy CLI | wrangler `^4.84.1` (`npm run deploy` = `vite build && wrangler deploy`) |

### Tests

| Concern | Tool | Version | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Unit runner | vitest | `^2.0.0` | `jsdom` environment, `globals: true` (`vitest.config.js`); `npm run test:unit` = `vitest run tests/unit` |
| Unit DOM env | jsdom | `^24.1.0` | required for `tests/unit` DOM-touching specs |
| Assertions (unit) | vitest built-in `expect` | bundled with vitest | e.g. `tests/unit/payload.test.js` |
| Integration runner | `@playwright/test` | `^1.44.0` | `playwright.config.js`; runs against `npm run dev -- --port 4173` |
| Assertions (integration) | `@playwright/test` `expect`/`page` API | bundled | e.g. `tests/integration/disable-form.spec.js` |
| Mocks | not found | — | no mock library in `devDependencies`; tests inject fakes via plain function args (`fetchImpl`, `onRedirect`) instead |
| Coverage tool | vitest coverage | bundled with vitest `^2.0.0` | `vitest.config.js` configures `reporter: ['text','html']` but no `npm run coverage` script wires it up |

### Linting

| Tool | Config | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| ESLint (flat config) | `eslint.config.js` | `@eslint/js` `^9.25.1` `recommended` ruleset; ignores `node_modules/`, `dist/`, `build/`, `coverage/`, `playwright-report/`, `test-results/`; `npm run lint` = `eslint .` |

### External integrations

| System | Client wiring |
|---|---|
| Merchant webhook (runtime-configured URL) | `globalThis.fetch` (or injected `fetchImpl`) with `AbortController` timeout in `src/integrations/webhook.js` |
| Google Tag Manager | direct `window.dataLayer.push()` in `src/integrations/gtm.js`, no GTM SDK dependency |
| Cloudflare Pages/Workers | `wrangler` CLI + `wrangler.jsonc`, `@cloudflare/vite-plugin` for dev/build integration |
